Question 4
?

The function L(s)=s2ln⁡s models the surface area of a flower's petal, in squared millimeters, as the flower's stem grows to a length of s centimeters, where s>1. What is the instantaneous rate of change of the surface area as a function of s?

a
s(2ln⁡s+1) squared millimeters per centimeter
b
2ln⁡s+1 squared millimeters per centimeter
c
1−2ln⁡s squared millimeters per centimeter
d
s2(2ln⁡s−1) squared millimeters per centimeter
e
s(ln⁡s+2) squared millimeters per centimeter
